Construction: Westbound I-84 is now closed as crews move the new bridge into place. The closure began Friday, November 6, at 10 p.m. and is expected to remain in place through Monday, November 9, at 6 a.m. A signed detour route is in place. Drivers should follow posted detour signs and allow extra travel time.
Construction: Southbound I-15 is closed between 200 North and Park Lane from Friday, 11/6 at 10:00 p.m. through Saturday, 11/7 at 6:00 a.m.
